title: Deployment warmup chef notes and cadence schematic (2026-09)
body:
Purpose
---
Notes and a lightweight cadence schematic for warmup -> micro-canary -> ramp -> steady state for medium-sized product rollouts (tier: hosted-api, medium traffic). Use as a field guide for the on-call + deploy conductor. Working doc — lots of TODOs and checkboxes.

High-level goals
- Make launches quiet: avoid user-visible latency/cost spikes.
- Protect SLOs while exercising new artifacts (model version, routing change, batching tweak).
- Keep rollback simple: one flag, one route, two minutes.

Runbook at-a-glance (compact checklist)
- [ ] Preflight: smoke builds on staging (smoke-id: smoke-2026-09-14-1)
- [ ] Inventory: model weights, quantization profile, kernel variant, serving image hash
- [ ] Canary lane created and tagged in routing (canary/slot-7)
- [ ] Warmup pool: 3 warmup machines reserved in region (r-1, r-2, r-3) for 20m
- [ ] Telemetry gates configured (latency p95 < 300ms, error rate < 0.5%)
- [ ] Staffing: deploy conductor + SRE obs + Product PM on standby for first 90m
- [ ] Customer comms draft (if >10% traffic change)

Cadence schematic (timeline; day 0 = rollout start)
- Day -2: preflight builds, perf benching (local scale), create experiment tag
- Day -1: staging warmup: run synthetic prefix warmers, exercise KV cache priming, validate tracing hooks
- Day 0, T+0: deploy canary (0.5% traffic) -> warmup: actively send 5x synthetic requests/min for 20m
- T+20m: evaluate telemetry gates; if pass -> increase to 2% traffic for 40m
- T+60m: re-evaluate; if pass -> 10% for 60m (micro-ramp)
- T+120m: 50% for 30m (fast-check)
- T+150m: full ramp to target routing (gradual until 100% or preserved split)
- Post-ramp: quiet-window 24h sampling with enhanced telemetry (see sampling plan)

Telemetry sampling plan (practical)
- Default sampling: 0.5% of requests with full traces, 5% with enriched metrics for first 24h
- Prefix caching metrics: sample 1000 warmup prefixes per region, log KV hit ratios, latency delta pre/post
- Error taxonomy: capture top-5 message types; for unknown errors, flag for triage and auto-rollback if error rate jumps >1% absolute

Smoke & validation checklist (pre-commit -> preflight)
- Binary checks: image signature matches release tag (sha256)
- Model checks: checksum, tokenizer version, config flags (use_fused_attention true/false)
- Perf checks: local synthetic latency median and p95 vs baseline (within +15%)
- Functional tests: tool-calling integration, function stubs exercised, streaming endpoint trimmed tests

Operator notes (practical heuristics)
- Warmup should be synthetic but representative; use small but real prefixes instead of random tokens.
- Avoid large-scale cold-starts during business hours for high-traffic routes; prefer nights or low-peak windows.
- If p95 latency rises with high KV hit ratio drop, suspect cache priming mismatch -> hold ramp and re-run prefix warmers.

Release notes draft (to cut/paste to release brief)
- Title: perf/serving: model-v2.3 rollout (2026-09)
- Summary: rolling deployment of model-v2.3 with updated KV cache eviction and quantization profile. Expected customer impact: none; reduced tail latency for generation tasks by ~8% in folded benchmarks.
- Notable changes:
  - Default quantization: int8-fast (new kernel)
  - KV cache eviction reduced to 48h from 72h for memory-limited pools
  - Routing: canary split via canary/slot-7 -> will be used for staged rollouts
- Rollout plan links: ENGREL-4123 (ticket), PR #2891 (runtime change), conf:/release/cadence-warmup-2026

Contingencies and quick rollback playbook
- Quick rollback switch: route.old = route.current; route.new -> off (single toggle in routing service)
- Fallback variants: if quantized kernel unstable on a GPU family, fallback to fp16 kernel variant (variant 'fp16-slow')
- Capacity fallthrough: if dedicated warmup pool loses >1 node, pause ramp and open backfill ticket to infra (tag infra-warmup)

Open questions / TODOs
- Should we add an automated prefix rehearsal job that runs 3x/day? (Priya to prototype)
- Can Product own the public-facing short note for customers? (Product PM to draft)
- Are we comfortable with sampling 0.5% traces for customers on PII-sensitive routes? (security review needed)

Runbook snippets (copyable one-liners)
- Evaluate gate: curl -s https://telemetry.internal/api/gates?canary=slot-7 | jq .status
- Toggle rollback: curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/toggle -d '{"route":"product-gen","target":"stable"}'
- Warmup runner (local): python infra/tools/warmup.py --model v2.3 --region r-1 --prefix-file warmers/short-prefixes.txt --duration 20m

Notes-to-self / rough ideas
- Consider a tiny "gradualness" knob: fewer hops between steps (0.5 -> 1.0 -> 2 -> 5 -> 10%) to smooth telemetry noise.
- Build a small dashboard for warmup traffic: show KV hit, p95 diff, error delta and a single red/yellow/green line for the gate.

Appendix: staffing snapshot for rollout window (T0 + 3h)
- Deploy conductor: Maya Chen (lead)
- SRE: Ethan Rivera (obs), Noah Brooks (infra)
